title: Brute Force Authentication Pattern
text: Repeated failed authentication attempts from one source to many targets. High connection count with low payload and short intervals.

title: Port Scan Behavior
text: Single source probing many destination ports and hosts within short time windows. Often low bytes and high fan-out.

title: Command and Control Beaconing
text: Regular periodic outbound connections to rare destinations with consistent packet size and timing.

title: DDoS-like Traffic Burst
text: High-rate traffic bursts targeting one service from many origins, elevated flow counts and sustained throughput spikes.
